verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯ : ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਤੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੇ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 19 : sirashaTee te sirashaTe dhaa praba(n)dh

en.bdb: The relation between the creation and the creator

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਵਣ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: pavan guroo gur sabadh hai raag naadh veechaaraa|

en.bdb: The basis of the world is air (the mixture of gases) and Sabad (Word) is the Guru of all knowledge from which flow further all thoughts, music and attendant sounds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਜਲੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: maat pitaa jal dharat hai utapat sa(n)saaraa|

en.bdb: Mother and father are the creative forces in the form of earth and water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੁ ਵਰਤੇ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhaiee dhaiaa raat dhih varate varataaraa|

en.bdb: Night and day are the nurses who nurse for the creatures and this way the whole system goes on operating.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਦਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਮੇਲੁ ਪਰਕਿਰਤਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: siv sakatee dhaa khel mel parakirat pasaaraa|

en.bdb: With the combination of Siva (the consciousness) and Sakti (the inert nature) this whole world comes into being.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਘਟਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਅਕਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham ghaT cha(n)dh akaaraa|

en.bdb: That transcendental perfect Lord is permeating through all as the same moon in the sky is visualised in all the pitchers of water.
That Lord beyond all the sustenances is the sustenance for the gurmukhs and He alone operates through all.
